blocks.text: Association do classes ke beech relationship (rishta) hai. Is ki do types hain:

items: Aggregation: ek class (maslan Library) doosri class (maslan Book) ko rakhti hai magar us ki owner (maalik) nahi. Kitabein library ke baghair bhi alag se reh sakti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke code mein yeh ghaltiyan hain: self, books = [ ] (comma) ki jagah self.books = [ ] (dot) hona chahiye, warna ValueError aata hai; def add_book Library class ke andar indented hona chahiye aur us ki dono lines us ke neeche (print line zyada aage khiski hui hai); aur "added to the library.” tirchhi quote par khatam hai, is liye string band nahi hoti. Theek code oopar hai.

Wazahat: Book ka object add_book method ke zariye Library ko diya jata hai aur woh library ki books list mein jur jata hai. Maslan lib = Library(); lib.add_book(Book("Python Basics")) se "Book  Python Basics added to the library." print hota hai.
Yeh aggregation ki misaal hai: Book objects alag bante hain aur phir Library mein jorte hain. titles ki list mein kitabon ke naam badal kar ya barha kar Run karein.
Composition: ek class (maslan House) doosri class (maslan Room) ko rakhti bhi hai aur us ki maalik bhi hai. Rooms (kamre) ghar ke baghair nahi reh sakte.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab self.name = name ko margin par chhapti hai; yeh __init__ ke andar indented honi chahiye (IndentationError). House ke andar print mein tirchhe quotes (“ ”) hain jo Python nahi maanti; seedhe quotes lagayein. Aakhri line print("House with rooms created.") class ke bahar ek faltu copy hai. Ghar house = House() se banta hai, aur yeh "House with rooms created" print karta hai.
Wazahat: House object ke andar Room objects ki list hai ('Living Room' aur ' Bedroom'). House apne kamre khud banata hai, is liye kamre ghar ka hissa hain; yahi composition hai.

blocks.prompt: Student aur school aggregation hai ya composition?
blocks.explanation: Aggregation: school mein students hain, magar student school ke baghair bhi apni jagah maujood rehta hai.

items: Composition: rakhti bhi aur maalik bhi (House-Room).
